admission.justification: A second independently sorted center diverges from the sidebar, so keyboard navigation and the shown semantic roster cease to agree.

applicability: The family member reading list and navigation tree over the same page change-set model and chosen stored sort.
conditions: The page change-set model supplies invariant identities in exactly the displayed order while the reading list retains distinct before/after member revisions.
Members outside the model (for example hidden in Changed) follow in their own stable relative order.
Outside the review page model, an outlined group supplies display positions and the existing entry order applies when no outline covers the family.
exclusions: Inventing an outline, classifying change facts on the client, or deleting semantic siblings.

evidence: ReviewSurface.triage.test.tsx green incl. DIAGNOSTIC-mutation discriminator proof (s6-f1-proof-fail.log fails as required; s6-focused-final.log green)

statement: The family center member list follows the sidebar tree's displayed order, and the selected changed statement's actual words are asserted through the word-diff DOM.
